name: sci0_rx_assemble
role: SCI0 RX byte handler: assembles bytes into channel ring slot (ch table 0x12CD8, stride 0x18), per-byte

name: ipc_pump
role: main-loop IPC pump: bsr dequeue (FFEDC1F6) then bsr FFEDEF97

name: ring_dequeue
role: dequeue one 300-byte slot; mirrors opcode bytes to 0x84C8/0x84C9; copies slot to pending 0x8E46 via FFEF0385

name: slot_to_pending
role: memcpy(0x8E46, slot, 0x12C) via sub_FFEFB268

name: link_entry
role: calls FFEDC615 then the link-layer dispatcher FFEDC976

name: link_dispatch
role: link-layer frame dispatcher: F00F power-down, FC00/FE00/FFFF/FFxx block protocol, F3D5/F3D6, common header +7..9, enqueue

name: classifier_enqueue
role: enqueue N bytes into the 4-slot classifier ring (write idx 0x84C6, read idx 0x84C7, slot stride 0x12C, data +0x8016, len +0x800E)

name: reply_FFFE
role: abort block state + send 2-byte FF FE reply to MAIN via FFEDD182 (type 0xE2)

name: block_readback
role: FE00 handler: read block n from ext RAM 0x070E1000 and transmit it back to MAIN via FFEDD182 (type 0xFF)

name: sub_to_main_tx
role: SUB->MAIN frame transmitter (writes reply buffer at 0x84CA, type code in r1)

name: apply_FC00
role: FC00 bulk apply: unpack channel/band/settings record from frame into working struct 0x12534 and name buffers 0x10C66..0x11B66

name: apply_F3D5
role: F3D5 handler: copy identity/name fields to 0x1032D/0x1033A, validate vs ROM template FFF38B7E (clone/pair handshake step)

name: apply_F3D6
role: F3D6 handler: copy fields to 0x10358/0x1034B, validate vs ROM FFF38BDA, send ack frames (FFEDD528) from 0x10369

name: lcd_cmd
role: write command byte (r1) to LCD controller at 0x06000000, bracketed by 0x8C028.2 strobe

name: lcd_display_off
role: F000: load 0x28 -> lcd_cmd (display OFF)

name: lcd_display_on
role: F001: load 0x29 -> lcd_cmd (display ON)

name: f0_state
role: F0 case 0/1: write r1 to state byte 0x8A8A

name: jpeg_load_display
role: load image file in 0x400 chunks to 0x070E1000, decode (FFEDE804) to framebuffer 0x070BB800, blit to LCD

name: jpeg_decode
role: JPEG decode: input 0x070E1000 (0x14000), output 0x070BB800 (0x25800), clamp routine FFF4C9D1

name: fb_surface_init
role: init draw-surface descriptor 0x1D3B8: base 0x07000000, 320x240 (0x140 x 0xF0)

name: draw_prim
role: drawing primitive onto the 0x07000000 framebuffer surface

name: fb_to_lcd_blit
role: program EXDMAC (0x00082800): dest = LCD 0x06000000, push framebuffer region to panel

name: ipc_send
role: frame builder/sender from 0xFF3D72 mailbox; special-cases FC00/F3D5/>=FE00; DMA ch0 to SCI_6

name: send_FFFF_block
role: FFFF block-write sender: total 0x116, len 0x10C (=256 payload), block# 0xFFBC40, total# 0xFFBC42, 32-bit cksum 0xFFBC44 at frame +0x0F; src ptr in er5

name: send_FE00_req
role: FE00 block-readback request: carries 0xFFBC40 (block) and 0xFFBC42 (total)

name: send_FD00
role: FD00 sender (adjacent bulk opcode)

name: send_FC00
role: FC00 bulk-settings sender via payload filler 71196

name: fill_FC00
role: FC00 payload filler (settings/memory record)

name: block_src_select
role: selects 256-byte source buffer among 0xFF5806/5906/5A06/5B06, calls B610

name: block_flush
role: flushes remaining bytes (0xFFB098 counter) via B610
